Lessons.Title: Lots of Fractions to Add
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will find the sum of three or more tenths and hundredths.
Key idea: A multi-term sum of tenths and hundredths can be computed by regrouping for friendly totals.
How to reason: Use equivalence 1/10=10/100, then group known friendly parts without dropping place value.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Number Talk: A Bunch of Numbers (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Activity 1: Stack Centavos and Pesos (25 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as 1 centavo, \(\frac{12}{100}\), 3, 1. First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2: More Than Two Fractions (10 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as Find the value of at least 3 of the expressions. Show your reasoning., \(\frac{2}{100} + \frac{13}{10} + \frac{1}{10} + \frac{8}{100}\), \(\frac{50}{10} + \frac{16}{100} + \frac{2}{10}\), \(\frac{3}{10} + \frac{4}{100} + \frac{7}{10} + \frac{26}{100}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
Original source Cool-down is access-restricted/unverified; Edulytics substitutes goal-aligned independently authored teacher-reviewed exit prompt.
Edulytics worked model: Add 3/10 and 4/100.. Explain every transformation and check using equal wholes/units.
Open reflection: Original centavo/peso stacks and multiple-coin comparison contexts are teacher reviewed.
